title: My Friend Tom and His Dog
text:
My friend Tom is tall and thin. He has short brown hair and big blue eyes. He wears a green shirt today. He is very funny.

Tom has a small dog named Max. Max is brown and fluffy. He has a long tail and a red collar. Max is always happy to see Tom.

questions.text: What is the name of Tom's dog?
What kind of person is Tom probably?
How does Max probably feel about Tom?
options: He is always happy to see Tom

vocabulary.definition: having a greater height than most people
soft and covered with light, thick fur or hair
a band worn around the neck of an animal

paragraph_translations: Mi amigo Tom es alto y delgado. Tiene el pelo corto y castaño y los ojos grandes y azules. Hoy lleva una camisa verde. Es muy divertido.
Tom tiene un perro pequeño llamado Max. Max es marrón y esponjoso. Tiene una cola larga y un collar rojo. Max siempre está feliz de ver a Tom.
